mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_conversation WHERE idempotency_hash=#{hash} AND
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_conversation SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND AND revision=#{revision} AND revision<200
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM knowledge_turn WHERE turn_id=#{id} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_turn WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND idempotency_hash=#{hash} AND
SELECT * FROM knowledge_turn WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND sequence>#{after} AND ORDER BY sequence ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM knowledge_turn WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ((dispatch_state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (dispatch_state='SENDING' AND lease_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY created_at,turn_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_turn SET dispatch_state='SENDING',dispatch_attempts=dispatch_attempts+1, lease_epoch=lease_epoch+1,lease_owner=#{worker},revision=revision+1,error_code=NULL, lease_expires_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,#{leaseSeconds},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE turn_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND dispatch_attempts<5 AND ((dispatch_state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (dispatch_state='SENDING' AND lease_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))

UPDATE knowledge_turn SET dispatch_state='FAILED',lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL, error_code=#{code},revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE turn_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND dispatch_attempts=5 AND ((dispatch_state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (dispatch_state='SENDING' AND lease_expires_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))

UPDATE knowledge_turn SET dispatch_state='PENDING',dispatch_attempts=0,retry_count=retry_count+1, error_code=NULL,revision=revision+1,next_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE turn_id=#{id} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND AND dispatch_state='FAILED' AND retry_count<3 AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_turn WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND dispatch_state IN ('PENDING','SENDING')
